bias.en: Turning back down · SAR flipped bearish, under the 30-day
bias.zh: 重新转弱 · SAR 转空，跌回 30 日均线下方

read.en: Broadcom fell 5.5% on Oct 30 to $326.08, trading between $319.30 and $331.98 on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($338.9) and falling 10-day ($334.6), 30-day ($348.5), 100-day ($370.7) and 200-day ($367.7). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($352.40), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 博通 10月30日下跌 5.5%，收于 $326.08，盘中区间 $319.30–331.98，成交量为均量的 1.7 倍。股价低于上行的 5 日均线（$338.9）以及下行的 10 日（$334.6）、30 日（$348.5）、100 日（$370.7）和 200 日均线（$367.7）。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$352.40），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The two-day drop broke all three written supports ($333.7–349.6, incl. the 30-day), now resistance, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $332–334.6 (Oct 30 high, 10-day), then $338.8–341.1 (5-day, Oct 29 low) and $348.5–352.4 (30-day, SAR). Support is $319.3–321 (Oct 30, 22 and 23 lows), then $314.1 (Jan 23 low) and $307.2–308.5. A close above $334.6 would target $339–341; below $319, $314.

r.en: 30-day average $348.5; Oct 28 high and Parabolic SAR $352.4
r.zh: 30日均线 $348.5；10月28日高点及抛物线 SAR $352.4
